title: aporocactus × mallisonii
intro: Aporocactus × mallisonii, commonly known as the 'Night-Blooming Cereus', is a hybrid succulent plant resulting from the cross between the genus Aporocactus and the genus Epiphyllum. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including the ability to help reduce anxiety and insomnia due to its sedative properties. The therapeutic actions of Aporocactus × mallisonii include its antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and anxiolytic effects, which contribute to its use in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and other compounds that have been identified as contributing to its therapeutic properties.
